_comment: Configuration file for the nori-embb-urllc-scenario. All values use SI units unless otherwise noted.

NR._comment: Physical parameters of the NR cell.

traffic._comment: Traffic profiles per slice type (eMBB, URLLC).

s1._comment: eMBB traffic: high throughput, less strict delay constraints.

s2._comment: eMBB traffic: high throughput, less strict delay constraints.

s3._comment: eMBB traffic: high throughput, less strict delay constraints.

eMBB._comment: eMBB traffic: high throughput, less strict delay constraints.

URLLC._comment: URLLC traffic: lower throughput, higher reliability/low latency.

slices._comment: RAN slicing configuration: number of UEs per slice and associated traffic type.
